_comment: Sound for the 6.5s ender. Sibling to the story, not a copy of it: the mark hits the water first and the trail answers behind it, so the strike leads and the bells follow. Same root as the story. Times match window.seek(t) in ender.html.

cues._: the V hits the water — the deepest strike in the piece, and the front travelling out from it
the trail arrives behind it, each copy a smaller wave
a warm chord under the line, resolving on the root
